scope: Review the conversion of one accepted rectangular-prism contract into a formal V21 .scscript.

checks.name: single_purpose
checks.notes: The operation generates and packages one rectangular-prism build artifact; it does not run SpaceClaim.

checks.name: parameterization
checks.notes: Geometry values and run paths are supplied by contracts and generator inputs.

checks.name: topology_safety
checks.notes: The generated source re-enumerates bodies and validates semantic geometry before save.

checks.name: evidence_boundary
checks.notes: Static generation and audit do not claim application execution or geometry correctness.

notes: The generated .scscript is the formal executable; the .py neighbor is editable packaging source only.
